item: wh10_flat_system_v1 (initial-scope stdlib EXACT probe, Q(zeta_5) with Fraction coefficients; resumed after the parent's WH10 v2 run settled, per parent IRC)
admission: initial scope: frozen <=300 s stdlib probe, single process, <=256 MiB RSS, <=16 MiB output; no numpy/native; PID recorded by the wrapper before compute; NOT a numerical enumeration
